+import base64
+import hashlib
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.getenv("AUTH0_DOMAIN", "")
+AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID", "")
+AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET", "")
+AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI = os.getenv("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI", "")
+AUTH0_TOKEN_URL = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/oauth/token" if AUTH0_DOMAIN else ""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class OAuthCallbackResult:
+    access_token: str
+    id_token: Optional[str]
+    refresh_token: Optional[str]
+    token_type: Optional[str]
+    expires_in: Optional[int]
+    scope: Optional[str]
+    raw: Dict[str, Any]
+
+
+def _code_verifier_digest(code_verifier: str) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(code_verifier.encode("utf-8")).digest()
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")
+
+
+def exchange_authorization_code(code: str, code_verifier: str, redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None) -> OAuthCallbackResult:
+    if not AUTH0_DOMAIN or not AUTH0_CLIENT_ID:
+        raise ValueError("AUTH0_DOMAIN and AUTH0_CLIENT_ID are required")
+    payload = {
+        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
+        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
+        "code": code,
+        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri or AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI,
+        "code_verifier": code_verifier,
+    }
+    headers = {"content-type": "application/json"}
+    if AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET:
+        payload["client_secret"] = AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET
+    response = requests.post(AUTH0_TOKEN_URL, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    return OAuthCallbackResult(
+        access_token=data["access_token"],
+        id_token=data.get("id_token"),
+        refresh_token=data.get("refresh_token"),
+        token_type=data.get("token_type"),
+        expires_in=data.get("expires_in"),
+        scope=data.get("scope"),
+        raw=data,
+    )
+
+
+def handle_callback(query_params: Dict[str, str], code_verifier: str, redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None) -> OAuthCallbackResult:
+    code = query_params.get("code")
+    error = query_params.get("error")
+    if error:
+        raise ValueError(query_params.get("error_description") or error)
+    if not code:
+        raise ValueError("Missing authorization code")
+    return exchange_authorization_code(code=code, code_verifier=code_verifier, redirect_uri=redirect_uri)
+

+import os
+import secrets
+import urllib.parse
+from typing import Dict, Optional
+
+
+AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.getenv("AUTH0_DOMAIN", "example.auth0.com")
+AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID", "")
+AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI = os.getenv("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI", "http://localhost:8000/callback")
+AUTH0_AUDIENCE = os.getenv("AUTH0_AUDIENCE", "")
+AUTH0_SCOPE = os.getenv("AUTH0_SCOPE", "openid profile email")
+
+
+def _build_authorize_url(state: str, nonce: str, extras: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> str:
+    params = {
+        "response_type": "code",
+        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
+        "redirect_uri": AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI,
+        "scope": AUTH0_SCOPE,
+        "state": state,
+        "nonce": nonce,
+    }
+    if AUTH0_AUDIENCE:
+        params["audience"] = AUTH0_AUDIENCE
+    if extras:
+        params.update({k: v for k, v in extras.items() if v is not None})
+    return f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/authorize?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params)}"
+
+
+def start_oauth_login(additional_parameters: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
+    nonce = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
+    authorize_url = _build_authorize_url(state, nonce, additional_parameters)
+    return {
+        "provider": "Auth0",
+        "authorize_url": authorize_url,
+        "state": state,
+        "nonce": nonce,
+        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
+        "redirect_uri": AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI,
+    }
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    result = start_oauth_login()
+    print(result["authorize_url"])
